items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: Yeah, Tony Jackson, yeah I know Tony Jackson well. ... he used to be around there.

ctx.x: You never remember hearing such as Tony Jackson or any of those?

Yeah, Tony Jackson, yeah I know Tony Jackson well. Oh you know him well? Yeah, he used to be around there. What I've seen I used to have to go in the bar to get my uncle to give him some money. When I used to go in there and say, you know you don't belong in here. I said, oh well it's alright. I said, uncle I just want a couple of nickels you know. And when he gave it to him I go and buy my bill.
How was his playing, can you remember that?
